detailsTitle: What changed — and what did not
details: Blender corner-pin compositing places a brand header and redesigned call controls inside the wall display.
The interface uses the existing MediConnect typography, brand and theme colours; no new AI footage was generated.
The original clinician image remains visible. This is planar compositing, not a reconstructed 3D room or recovered camera path.
The display enters near the end of the film. On narrow mobile crops, part of the display is outside the homepage's portrait framing.
